title.narrative: Chennai Metro Rail Investment Project - Tranche 2

description.narrative: The Chennai Metro Rail Investment Project contributes in the expansion of the existing metro rail network in Chennai, the capital city of Tamil Nadu, a state on the south-east coast of India. The investment project will develop Lines 3 and 4, connecting the central area of Chennai to key points in the south and west of the city. The second tranche will continue to cover the civil works related to underground tunneling and stations along the Line 4 corridor, and the construction of viaducts along the Line 3 corridor. It also includes planning activities on urban renewal and livability improvement through the attached TA. The remaining tranche will gradually finance the contracts as they progress, and the periodic financing request will be issued based on disbursement projections.
